description: Header file defining the uci_pusch_pdu_builder class, which provides methods to build and set parameters for UCI PUSCH PDU messages in a 5G NR protocol implementation.

classes.name: uci_pusch_pdu_builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing and setting parameters of UCI PUSCH PDU messages.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets UE-specific parameters in the PDU, such as RNTI.

methods.name: set_metrics_parameters
methods.description: Sets metrics parameters including SINR, RSSI, and RSRP in the PDU.

methods.name: set_harq_parameters
methods.description: Sets HARQ parameters in the PDU.

methods.name: set_csi_part1_parameters
methods.description: Sets CSI Part 1 parameters in the PDU.

methods.name: set_csi_part2_parameters
methods.description: Sets CSI Part 2 parameters in the PDU.
